representative_scale.selection: All cases with both primary apo_R and apo_L within PINDER-S; sort IDs and freeze before execution.

secondary_challenge.mode: Separate bound-component redocking, never pooled with 93 apo cases.
secondary_challenge.reason: Assembly, chain and domain extraction must be resolved from structures; brief gives no exact extraction command.

inputs.experimental: Primary apo receptor/ligand pairs; native holo dimers; index, metadata and mappings, all pinned in data.json.
inputs.software: Pinned PINDER code and permitted-for-use unverified FroDock mirror with required bin/soap.bin.
inputs.configuration: Exactly five retained solutions, eight MPI ranks; same fixed case set and search settings for comparisons.
inputs.generated: Prepared monomer PDBs and potential grids; not missing external data.
inputs.seed_reason: No source specifies values or seed plumbing.

outputs.poses: results_dir/frodock/{pinder_id}/apo_decoys/model_{i}.pdb, i=1..5; complete receptor and ligand with chain IDs R and L.

scoring_interface.ranking: PINDER extracts rank from trailing number in model filename.
scoring_interface.missing_cases: Keep failures in 93-case denominator; report incomplete output explicitly.

outputs.scientific_comparison: Top-1 versus highest DockQ among same five candidates. Apply DockQ >= 0.23 per pose. Report paired per-case outcomes; do not infer ranking improvement from oracle coverage.
outputs.performance: End-to-end elapsed seconds, candidate throughput, time to first acceptable candidate, resource use and actual cost; no published target established.

timing_scope.setup: Acquisition, dependency install and compilation separately from docking; no work performed here.
timing_scope.method_run: Wall clock from prepared monomer pair availability through grid construction, docking search, clustering, coordinate output and result copy. Include all eight adapter stages, process-launch overhead and synchronization.
timing_scope.reporting: Report per-case and total elapsed time, actual CPU/MPI and any GPU resources; inference and scoring kept distinct. Time-to-acceptable requires emitted-candidate timestamps and retrospective native scoring; absent timestamp data remains unavailable.
timing_scope.cost: Use actual resource billing rate and elapsed usage; no prices assumed.
timing_scope.runtime_reason: No measured representative runtime or stock-image limits established. No runtime extrapolation, doubling loop or guarantee of completion within defaults.

budget_policy: Use prompt defaults: setup/anchors/profile/method_setup/method_run=1200 s, tests=900 s, evaluate=2400 s. No workload run during intake. Later scripts must enforce deadlines; whether full representative workload finishes is unknown, not evidence of infeasibility.

repeatability.fixed_case_selection: All PINDER-S cases in release 2024-02 with both primary apo monomers, sorted by ID; expected count 93. No case-size search.
repeatability.seed_reason: Brief requests independent random seeds but gives no values, count or FroDock seed interface; do not invent. Record stochastic transform/search seeds before later execution. Deterministic reruns do not count as independent search.
repeatability.candidate_count_basis: Intake fixed retained-pose count, using published top-5 evaluator interface; not asserted to be the study search budget or original candidate count.

limitations: FroDock software and scoring bytes have unverified_mirror provenance. Owner authorizes their use. Original study byte identity remains unresolved; passing anchors does not authenticate these materials.
